prospective_task_learning.notes: Adds occurrence identity, immutable event files, explicit review membership, assessment coverage and idempotent retries.

framework_feedback_capture.notes: Adds local-only export default, sensitivity/redaction state, immutable observation records and secret fail-closed capture.

retrospective_task_learning.notes: Retrospective tooling is not part of the Stable project pin. V2 adds occurrence identity, frozen source provenance and amendments.

upgrade_planning.notes: Approval-eligible plans derive baseline metadata and changed paths from resolved Git objects.

eval_assurance.notes: Malformed or missing trace/metadata evidence cannot satisfy dependent assertions; execution coverage is reported separately.

central_feedback_decisions.notes: Central review decisions are machine-readable and separate from immutable source observations.

project_assurance_reference_integrity.notes: Prospective feedback-driven guard for missing literal repository-local workflow scripts and local actions; dynamic references remain outside static proof.

architecture_deepening_analysis.notes: Stable V1 capability. Promoted from real brownfield evidence across inventory search, match scoring, and broker CRM; see evidence/ARCHITECTURE_DOMAIN_LANGUAGE_STABLE_PROMOTION_V1.json. Structural changes still require normal architecture approval.

behavior_first_testing.notes: EREI-native behavior-first red-to-green tracer slices through approved public test seams; complements rather than replaces final verification. Remains Candidate pending one authoritative behavioral RED-to-GREEN execution.

domain_language_modeling.notes: Stable V1 capability. Promoted after a real EREI-App-Google auth/CRM/idempotency ambiguity produced a canonical glossary verified against current code; see evidence/ARCHITECTURE_DOMAIN_LANGUAGE_STABLE_PROMOTION_V1.json.
